notes:
- Prison: the Riot Guard. Black riot armour, helmet and shoulder pads. Body shots glance off (sparks
  and a ping) and only do a third of the damage. Headshots get through. Enough body damage cracks the
  armour off, and then it charges you. It hits harder than the others. From round 4.
- Lab: the Bloater. Swollen and covered in glowing green pustules. It bursts when it dies and leaves a
  toxic cloud for 7 seconds that hurts anyone standing in it (your screen goes green). Kill it from a
  distance. From round 3.
- Outskirts: the Stalker. Grey, hunched, long-armed, with white eyes. Fast but fragile. When you're a
  few metres away it crouches, shrieks and leaps at you. From round 3.
- The Hospital keeps its Screamer.
- New stats and challenges: Riot Guards put down, Bloaters popped and Stalkers killed, with Riot
  Control, Hazard Pay and The Hunter Hunted (2,500 XP each).
